android.desc:
Svanq is a social media platform that focuses on knowledge sharing and Q&A through short and entertaining video answers. Users can ask questions, and others respond with video answers rather than traditional text-based replies, making learning and sharing more engaging and visual.

Svanq: Knowledge Sharing Through Video Answers

Are you tired of sifting through endless text to find answers? Enter Svanq, your gateway to a world of knowledge delivered in short, engaging videos.

Discover and Share Knowledge: Svanq is a unique Q&A network where you ask questions, and the answers come in the form of captivating video responses. No more slogging through lengthy articles or boring text; knowledge sharing has never been this interactive and entertaining.

Modern Social Media Features: Svanq seamlessly combines the best of modern social media while safeguarding your privacy and never selling or monitoring your data. You can upload your short video answers or comments on intriguing questions, and let others join the conversation.

Comments and Interactions: Engage with your fellow users by leaving comments on their content and receiving feedback on your own. It's a vibrant community where knowledge flows freely.

Content Tagging and Filtering: Organize your content by tagging it into various categories. Filter your feed to see only the topics that interest you the most, ensuring a personalized experience.

Efficient Content Search: Looking for specific content, questions, or users? Our highly optimized search feature ensures you find what you need swiftly.

Public Profiles: Showcase your expertise and interests on your public profile, allowing others to see and appreciate the valuable content you've shared.

Gain Knowledge and Connect: Svanq not only serves knowledge in entertaining videos but also facilitates social connections and easy content discovery. Customize your dashboard, explore a tailored feed, and connect with like-minded individuals.

Join the Knowledge Revolution: Dive into a world of wisdom served through engaging videos, complemented by the convenience of social media features and intuitive content discovery.

Experience the future of knowledge sharing with Svanq - the Q&A platform that revolutionizes learning and interaction. Download the app now!

quotes.text:
I started a YouTube channel just for fun, featuring my 9-month-old daughter and 5-year-old son in funny videos - https://www.youtube.com/@TaughtbByLife/shorts

On the tech side, I built https://svanq.com, a Q&A platform where people ask questions, and others respond with short video clips instead of text. It’s also available on Android: Svanq App- https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.svanqapp&hl=en

I'm currently working on another app where users can ask questions with multiple-choice options. Users earn points for answering, which they can later redeem for cash or digital rewards. Previously, I've created social networking apps like Frendsdom and Circleshouts—I love creating social, fun, and unique apps.

I'm also on the lookout for side gigs like technical project management, Freelancing, CTO, partnerships, or any projects that can make a meaningful impact.

If you’re like-minded, let’s connect!
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: What are you working on? (October 2024)
